nodes.title: Place the volumetric flask
nodes.description: Place the clean, dry 100 mL volumetric flask on the bench.

validation.label: Place the volumetric flask was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Place the volumetric flask and try again.

nodes.title: Seat the funnel
nodes.description: Seat the filling funnel in the neck of the volumetric flask.

feedback.retry: Review Seat the funnel and try again.

nodes.title: Tip in the solid
nodes.description: Tip all of the {{config.soluteMassG}} g of sodium carbonate from the weighing boat into the funnel.

validation.label: Tip in the solid was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Tip in the solid and try again.

nodes.title: Rinse the boat
nodes.description: Hold the boat over the funnel and rinse it with three small squirts from the wash bottle, so the last grains wash into the flask.

feedback.retry: Review Rinse the boat and try again.

nodes.title: Rinse the funnel
nodes.description: Rinse the inside of the funnel with three small squirts from the wash bottle, so no solid is left on it.

feedback.retry: Review Rinse the funnel and try again.

nodes.title: Remove the funnel
nodes.description: Lift the funnel out of the flask and set it on the bench.

feedback.retry: Review Remove the funnel and try again.

nodes.title: Fill about half full
nodes.description: Add deionized water from the wash bottle until the flask is about half full.

validation.label: Fill about half full was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Fill about half full and try again.

nodes.title: Swirl to dissolve
nodes.description: Swirl the flask gently until no solid is left. A stirring rod is never put into a volumetric flask.

feedback.retry: Review Swirl to dissolve and try again.

nodes.title: Fill to below the mark
nodes.description: Add deionized water from the wash bottle until the level is just below the mark on the neck.

validation.label: Fill to below the mark was completed.

feedback.success: Fill to below the mark complete.
feedback.retry: Review Fill to below the mark and try again.

nodes.title: Fill a dropping pipette
nodes.description: Draw deionized water from the beaker into the dropping pipette.

validation.label: Fill a dropping pipette was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Fill a dropping pipette and try again.

nodes.title: Bring to the mark
nodes.description: Add water one drop at a time until the bottom of the meniscus touches the mark at eye level.

validation.label: Bring to the mark was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Bring to the mark and try again.

nodes.title: Stopper the flask
nodes.description: Seat the stopper firmly in the neck of the flask.

feedback.retry: Review Stopper the flask and try again.

nodes.title: Invert to mix
nodes.description: Holding the stopper in place, turn the flask upside down and back about ten times.

feedback.retry: Review Invert to mix and try again.

nodes.title: Record the solution's appearance
nodes.description: Record in the notebook what the finished solution looks like.

validation.label: Record the solution's appearance was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Record the solution's appearance and try again.
